items.raw_excerpt: Keralam Opposition Leader Pinarayi Vijayan refutes claims of delayed road connectivity to Vizhinjam port, calling them 'baseless.'
items.summary_en: Kerala Opposition Leader Pinarayi Vijayan dismissed allegations that he delayed road construction to the Vizhinjam port. He called the Chief Minister's claims 'baseless.'

items.raw_excerpt: Tokelau has lost more than 60 percent of its fishing revenue between February and June, according to New Zealand officials, following its expulsion from a key Pacific fisheries agreement.
items.summary_en: Tokelau has lost more than 60 percent of its fishing revenue since February. The loss came after the tiny Pacific territory was expelled from a key regional fisheries agreement. New Zealand officials confirmed the sharp drop in income.

items.title_en: Tokelau loses most fishing money after being kicked out of Pacific deal

items.raw_excerpt: Os vencedores do prêmio serão conhecidos na próxima quarta-feira (26), em evento no Cais do Sertão, no Bairro do Recife
items.summary_en: CBN Recife has been selected as a finalist for the Sebrae Journalism Award with two nominations. Winners will be announced next Wednesday at an event held at Cais do Sertão in Recife. The award honors outstanding journalism work in the region.

items.summary_en: The 2nd Mardi Gras Recife festival will take place on September 19th in Recife Antigo. The event brings together Jazz and Frevo music to enliven the historic streets.

items.raw_excerpt: Kazuyoshi Miura on Wednesday scored twice from the penalty spot as the 59-year-old striker became the oldest goalscorer in the history of Japan's longest-running cup competition. Miura, known as "King Kazu" and now in his 42nd season as a professional, played a key role as third division Fukushima United thrashed…
items.summary_en: Japanese footballer Kazuyoshi Miura, 59, scored twice from the penalty spot in the Emperor's Cup. The player known as 'King Kazu' set a new record as the oldest goalscorer in the tournament's history. Miura is now in his 42nd season as a professional footballer.
items.summary_ko: 59세 일본 축구선수 키자시 미우라가 천황배에서 페널티킥 두 골을 성공시켰다. '킹 카즈'로 불리는 그는 이 대회 역사상 최고령 득점자가 되었다. 미우라는 현재 프로 42번째 시즌을 맞이하고 있다.
items.title_en: King Kazu, 59, Becomes Oldest Scorer in Japan's Emperor's Cup

items.title_original: King Kazu, 59, scores twice from spot to make cup history

items.raw_excerpt: DC says DJ sound systems had been prohibited during the Gowri-Ganesh festival as excessive noise could inconvenience senior citizens, children and pregnant women. Instead, organisers should promote traditional folk performances, such as Dollu Kunitha, Hejje Mela and Karadi Majalu, she said.
items.summary_en: The Deputy Commissioner of Dharwad, India, has banned plaster of Paris Ganesh idols and announced a fine of one lakh rupees for excessive DJ sound during the Gowri-Ganesh festival. The ban aims to protect senior citizens, children, and pregnant women from loud noise. Officials encouraged traditional folk performances instead.
items.summary_ko: 다르와드 부국장은 고리-간ে시 축제 기간 동안 콘센트 프라스 체로 만든 Ganesh 상을 금하고, 과도한 DJ 소음에 대해 1 lakh 루피의 벌금을 부과한다고 발표했습니다. 이 금지는 노인, 임산부 및 어린이를 큰 소음으로부터 보호하기 위한 것입니다. 관계자는 대신 전통 민속 공연을 장려할 것을 촉구했습니다.
items.title_en: Dharwad bans plaster Ganesh idols and loud DJ music during festival
items.title_ko: 다르와드, 콘센트 프라스 체 Ganesh 상 및 과도한 DJ 음악 금지
items.title_original: Dharwad bans PoP Ganesh idols, announces ₹1 lakh fine for excessive DJ sound

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland has had its worst week for flu hospitalisations in a decade.
items.summary_en: Auckland hospitals admitted 177 people with severe respiratory illness in one week, the highest rate since 2015. A mix of influenza A Subclade K, RSV, and rhinovirus is putting heavy pressure on the health system. Vaccination rates are rising and the current vaccine matches the dominant strain.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 4개 병원에 일주일간 177명의 중증 호흡기 질환자가 입원해 2015년 이후 최고치를 기록했다. 인플루엔자 A 서브클레이드 K 변이, RSV, 리노바이러스가 동시에 유행하며 의료 체계에 큰 압박을 주고 있다. 백신 접종이 늘고 있으며 현재 백신은 유행 변이와 잘 일치하는 것으로 확인됐다.
items.title_en: Auckland hits worst flu hospitalisation week in a decade
items.title_ko: 오클랜드, 10년 만에 최악의 독감 입원 주 기록
items.title_original: Auckland has its worst week for flu-related hospitalisations in 10 years

items.raw_excerpt: Plans to open a beer garden bar at a village pub have been given the go-ahead after councillors were assured that outdoor live music would no longer be allowed at the venue.
items.summary_en: Plans to open a beer garden bar at a village pub have been given the go-ahead. The approval came after councillors were assured that outdoor live music would no longer be allowed at the venue.

items.raw_excerpt: The premier denied there have been threats to cut investment in vital services, including for homelessness and child safety.
items.summary_en: The Queensland government has been accused of gagging frontline organisations from speaking out about cuts to vital services. The premier denied threats were made to reduce funding for homelessness and child safety programs.

items.raw_excerpt: A co-living pilot was among the initiatives announced under the SG Youth Plan launched last month, presenting it as an option for young people in Singapore.
items.summary_en: Singapore launched a co-living pilot as part of the SG Youth Plan to give young people more housing options. The program helps young adults who cannot yet afford to buy their own homes. Home ownership remains the long-term goal for most Singaporeans.

items.title_en: Co-living helps young Singaporeans find affordable housing

items.raw_excerpt: El Ayuntamiento amplía la actividad a dos jornadas tras convertirse en todo un fenómeno popular hace un año
items.summary_en: The town of Ontinyent in Valencia, Spain is bringing back its giant 100-meter water slide during the Moros y Cristianos festival. After a popular debut last summer, organizers expanded the event to two days this year, on August 22 and 23. The slide runs down Calle Músic Úbeda and is part of a family-friendly program called La Gran.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 발렌시아의 온티넨트 마을이 무로스 이 크리스티아노스 축제 기간에 100미터 대형 물 미끄럼틀을 다시 설치한다. 지난여름 첫 선을 보인 뒤 인기를 끌자 올해는 8월 22일과 23일 이틀간으로 확대 운영한다. 이 미끄럼틀은 뮤식 우베다 거리에 설치되며, 가족 단위 프로그램 '라 그란'의 일부로 진행된다.

items.raw_excerpt: The owner of the Rocky Point sugar mill sent a notice to growers in June advising them that the mill would cease crushing their cane after the 2027 season.
items.summary_en: The Rocky Point sugar mill in Queensland has ended its contract with local farmers. Farmers will need to find a new buyer after the 2027 season. Many growers are upset about the sudden change.
items.summary_ko: Queensland 지역의 Rocky Point 설탕공장이 농민들과의 계약을 종료했습니다. 농민들은 2027년 수확 시즌 이후 새로운 구매자를 찾아야 합니다. 많은 재배자들이 갑작스러운 변화에 실망하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Gold Coast sugar farmers devastated as mill ends contract

items.raw_excerpt: From documenting words on the verge of extinction to preserving village traditions and promoting literary activity, the Directorate of Official Language has invited proposals under three schemes for 2026-27. The ‘Amcho Ganv, Amchi Parampara, Amchem Daiz’ scheme encourages writers and locals to document Goa’s village traditions, rituals, customs, culture and heritage, with financial assistance offered […]
items.summary_en: The Goa government is inviting proposals to document village traditions, rituals, and local culture. It also supports efforts to preserve words that are at risk of disappearing. Writers and locals can receive financial assistance under three schemes for 2026-27.
items.summary_ko: 고아 주 정부가 마을 전통, 의식, 지역 문화를 기록하는 프로젝트를 공모하고 있다. 사라질 위기에 놓인 단어들을 보존하는 노력도 지원한다. 작가와 지역 주민은 2026-27년 3개 지원 사업을 통해 재정 지원을 받을 수 있다.

items.summary_en: Local politicians support a new development plan at Åstveit near Bergen. The plan includes 130 homes and a dedicated village for people living with dementia. The project aims to create a supportive community for elderly residents.
items.summary_ko: 베르겐 인근 오스트베이트에 130세대 주택과 치매 환자를 위한 전문 마을을 짓는 개발 계획이 현지 정치인들의 지지를 받고 있다. 이 사업은 고령 주민을 위한 돌봄 중심 커뮤니티를 만드는 것이 목표다.

items.raw_excerpt: Lake Zurich's water level sank to its lowest level in 75 years on August 19th, official measurements showed, as a drawn-out drought also took a toll on a range of other major Swiss lakes.
items.summary_en: Lake Zurich's water level fell to 404.45 metres above sea level on August 19th, breaking a record set in 1952. A months-long drought with repeated heatwaves and below-average rainfall has left many Swiss lakes unusually low. Ferry services on Lake Zurich have been restricted because the water is too shallow for heavy vehicles.
items.summary_ko: 8월 19일 취리히 호수의 수위가 해수면 대비 404.45m까지 떨어지며 1952년 이후 75년 만에 최저 기록을 경신했다. 올봄부터 이어진 폭염과 평년 이하의 강수량으로 스위스 전역의 호수가 급격히 낮아졌다. 호수가 너무 얕아져 취리히 호수 여객선의 차량 탑재 운항이 제한되고 있다.
items.title_en: Lake Zurich water level drops to lowest in 75 years
items.title_ko: 취리히 호수 수위가 75년 만에 최저치 기록
items.title_original: Lake Zurich sees water level hit record low amid drought

items.raw_excerpt: The action was sparked by the company carrying out two rounds of workforce reduction negotiations within six months, according to the chief shop steward.
items.summary_en: Postal workers at a Helsinki logistics hub have gone on strike. The walkout was triggered by two rounds of workforce reduction negotiations within six months. The chief shop steward said the action reflects workers' frustration over the repeated talks.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드 우체국 Posti의 헬싱키 물류센터 노동자들이 파업을 시작했다. 회사가 6개월 내 두 차례 인력 감축 협상을 진행한 것이 원인이다. 노조 대표는 이번 파업이 노동자들의 반복된 협상에 대한 불만을 반영한 것이라고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Posti workers at Helsinki logistics hub stage walkout
